caption:
Google is emailing Google AI Plus subscribers that they will lose access to Pro models in the Gemini app and AI Mode on November 13.
They keep Flash and Flash Lite. Pro models stay on Google AI Pro at $19.99 a month, four times the $4.99 Plus price.

Would you pay 4x to keep Pro?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.

Source: Android Authority, Windows Report

slides.headline: Google just told Gemini subscribers they're losing Pro models. Keeping them costs *4x more*

slides.heading: The *November 13* cutoff
paras: Google has started emailing Google AI Plus subscribers that they will lose the option to pick Pro models in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.
The date is November 13, 2026. After that, choosing Pro models is limited to Google AI Pro and higher plans, Android Authority reported.

slides.heading: What *AI Plus* keeps
paras: AI Plus subscribers keep Flash and Flash Lite models. Old chats that used a Pro model stay, but users must switch to another model to continue them.
Reddit users in r/GooglePixel and r/GeminiAI shared the email, and some questioned whether the cheaper plan is still worth it.

slides.heading: The *4x* math
paras: Google AI Plus costs $4.99 a month in the US and Google AI Pro costs $19.99, according to Google's plans page. Keeping Pro models means paying four times as much.

paras.t: Google had earlier expected these model changes to start on October 9.

slides.hook: Google keeps reshuffling who gets which Gemini model. Follow so the next change doesn't catch you off guard.
